Description

Verify the performance of space parts and secure space heritage. The satellite contains nine types of components developed in Korea and memory semiconductors such as Samsung Electronics' DRAM and NAND flash.
Results

All 12 Nuri-deployed cube satellites establish ground communication, 2025-12-08.
